💥 Try out the newer version of Car crash system! https://www.roblox.com/games/12182892999/Car-Crash-Drive#!/game-instances

🔥 Welcome to Car Crash System! This is a game about crashing your cars with a lot of different ways! You can drive, race and drift around the map and You can also destroy your car with different physics machines like Hammers, crushers, ramps, trains and much more! Have Demolition derby with your friends, Races, or whatever comes to your mind!

💥 MAKE SURE TO LEAVE A LIKE! With likes you can support our game and we will update our game more often!
